RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Precision barrel license
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: New whitelisted guns crafted by this pawn deal 15% more weapon damage. Requires Odyssey. Result is saved on the newly crafted gun; distinct licenses combine, duplicates do not. Applies only to revolvers, bolt-action rifles, chain shotguns, heavy SMGs, LMGs, assault/sniper/charge rifles, miniguns and charge lances. Native unique weapons, purchases and historical items are excluded.
